purpose: Complete attached alternative components on original intervals; label-free context and memory preparation only.
policy: Original one-hop contexts plus every alternative component touching the reference core and every reference boundary anchor of those components; no recursive expansion from added anchors. Preserve original stored directed/oriented links.
validity: Retain all original one-hop intervals in QC; check actual canonical segment disjointness in all five folds, whole frozen NT coverage, orientation preservation, and dense score storage. No labels or reconstruction-candidate filtering.
limits: Components are not verified bubbles or phased paths.
Dense score bytes omit activations/backward/optimizer; exceeding 24 GiB forbids that implementation, not the window.
No new model training until attention correctness and actual memory are verified.
